messages:
Avery: Quick sync — want to finalize three-pane homepage copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need hero options, one-liners, microcopy for pricing/SLAs, and routing rules for inbound leads. Target: get copy to design before EOD Friday.

Diego: Can we reuse the benchmark hook? e.g., "Latency you can bank on, cost you can measure." or keep more technical?

Priya: For Dedicated, lean on 'reserved capacity' + SLA. Suggested hero: "Predictable throughput. Enterprise SLAs." CTA: 'Request capacity estimate'

Sam: Hosted hero idea: "Get models in prod in minutes — pay per token." Short sub: "Curated models, streaming, and transparent perf." CTA: 'Start free' and 'See benchmarks'

Marta: Private page needs compliance first line. Hero: "Run inference where your data lives" Sub: "VPC, on-prem, KMS/HSM options." CTA: 'Talk to sales'

Avery: Love these. Need microcopy for the feature panel under hero: hosted bullets (streaming, tool calling), dedicated bullets (autoscale, burst, traffic shaping), private bullets (audit logs, on-prem pkg). Keep each 5 words max.

Priya: Draft bullets:
Hosted — "Streaming & low-latency, pay-as-you-go"
Dedicated — "Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed"
Private — "VPC & on-prem, KMS enabled"

Diego: For benchmarks narrative — propose single chart showing p95 latency vs cost per 1k tokens across model variants. Copy: "Real customers: 45% lower unit cost with batching+cache"

Sam: Webinar tie-in: demo 'Migrating from hosted to dedicated' and 'Securing inference on-prem' — want sign-up CTA on pages and a short 30s video embed.

Marta: Inbound routing: Please route leads with product_interest tag (hosted/dedicated/private) + company_size to Growth or AE queues. Example rule snippet:
```
if lead.product_interest == 'private' or lead.industry in ['healthcare','finance']:
  assign_queue = 'enterprise-AE'
elif lead.company_size > 500:
  assign_queue = 'AE'
else:
  assign_queue = 'growth'
```

Avery: Add UTM tracking & modal for benchmark download to capture MQLs. Also need urgent copy for "See benchmarks" modal header.

Priya: Modal header options: "Production benchmarks" or "Real-world perf and cost" — leaning second.

Diego: Quick AB test plan: test Hosted hero variant A (speed-first) vs B (cost-first) for CTR and signups. Track event: `hero_cta_click` with `product_panel` label.

Avery: OK — I'll consolidate and push to Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/...(placeholder). Reviewers: @diego @priya @sam @marta. Please add comments by Thurs 10am PST.

launch-bot: Reminder — design sync booked Fri 11:30am PST :calendar:

Sam: Signing off for today — will drop annotated screenshots later :+1:
